text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was able to beat the older girls...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...To think it was such a magnificent 
flower.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is only one reason for the defeat. 
You simply blossomed with such beauty... 
and that was all there was to it. 
Congratulations, Flower-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, absolutely! Rather than a little 
flower, that's a full-blown bloom.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Claiming victory in the Yasuda Kinen as 
well, she seized the Takarazuka Kinen into 
her grasp...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's something I could never hope to 
imitate. It was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wooww...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Getting praised that much makes me feel 
embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really might be a lovely little 
flower after all. It makes me want to 
praise you even more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"There you go again... It's truly 
terrifying how completely oblivious you 
are."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"We shall take our leave. The stage 
belongs to the victor now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san. You had the better of me 
today... but I look forward to the day we 
can compete against each other again."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it too! When the 
time comes...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely grow up to be a cool big 
sister, just like all of you...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I won the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! From now on, I can take on even more 
races!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's take on plenty of challenges. I'm 
sure that I...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be sure to hand the victory bouquet 
to you!"
